name: JellyBlindTest
description: Play a short random song preview and guess the title.
overview: Adds a five-round blind test game using songs from the signed-in user's Jellyfin library.

versions.changelog:
- Keep Start available while playlists load and support mobile tap-to-play restrictions.
- Hide Playlist, Artist, and Genre filters when their strategy is inactive.

- Add hierarchical Popular, Playlist, and Expert source configuration with artist and genre filters.
- Stack match badges in the song card's upper-left corner.

- Skip unplayable tracks and try another song.
- Clarify the guessing subtitle.
- Fix dependency plugin status detection.

- Add a compact vertical volume slider inside the song card.
- Show a compact round counter and truncate long stage text without resizing the card.

- Fade reveal audio out before the next round starts.
- Match song titles when parenthetical version text is omitted.

- Abort active sessions when navigating away from Blind Test.
- Keep the answer field writable throughout the session.
- Add a live music-volume slider that controls playback and crossfades.

- Show green Song and Artist match badges as guesses are found.
- Reveal the answer immediately when both have been matched.

- Keep guesses for the round cumulative so separate entries can compose an answer.
- Keep the answer field visible but disabled during reveal.
- Show every guess in the recap.
- Add album artwork, with artist-image fallback, as the leftmost column in the final recap.

- Add non-persistent per-session settings for rounds, guess/reveal timing, and ranked pool size.
- Highlight recap answers that earned points.
- Show required File Transformation/Jellyfin Enhanced and optional ranked Music Discovery status with links.

- Add Blind Test as a native Jellyfin 12 Home tab via Jellyfin Enhanced's native-tabs registry.
- Mount the game directly in the Home tab so it inherits the Jellyfin theme without an iframe.

- Add Blind Test as a native Jellyfin main-menu page instead of an iframe overlay.
- Inherit Jellyfin's active theme in the game page.

- Use Jellyfin's active theme in the game page.
- Fall back from album artwork to artist artwork, hiding artwork when neither is available.

- Show the song title, artist, and album artwork clearly during reveal, including popular-track mode.
- Add a global highest-ranked songs mode alongside artist-balanced popularity mode.
- Add Up/Down navigation through submitted answer history while the guessing phase is active.
- Add a JellyMusicDiscovery version-gated toggle for the artist-balanced Most popular mode.
- Add an artist-balanced Most popular mode using cached Deezer ranks and configurable top-N pool size.
- Add Most popular mode using cached server-wide Deezer ranks and a configurable top-N pool size.
- Warn when a selected audio playlist has fewer songs than the configured rounds.
- Add a source menu to play from the whole audio library or a selected audio playlist.
- Allow repeated guesses until reveal and show expected versus submitted answers for every round.
- Require over 80% fuzzy title and artist similarity, award both categories independently, and require a strict artist majority for collaborations.
- Accept 80% fuzzy song and artist matches, award up to two points per round, and require a strict artist majority for collaborations.
- Keep the answer field open while a single Guessing timer runs, continue music through reveal, and crossfade between songs.
- Merge preview and answer into one guessing phase, continue playback, and crossfade tracks between rounds.
- Inline the menu SVG, inherit the theme color, and make the question mark transparent.
- Straighten the paired noteheads and stems, and add an editable standalone SVG menu icon.
- Redesign the Blind Test menu icon as paired music notes with a circled question mark.
- Add a mirrored music-note SVG icon to the Blind Test main-menu link.

- Start the song with each round, show Music and Answer countdowns, reveal on timeout, and advance automatically after configurable reveal playback.
- Add configurable answer and reveal durations to Blind Test Settings.
- Fix the Settings link route from the embedded game back to Jellyfin Web.
- Fix the game script initialization after loading the page through Jellyfin's same-origin iframe.
- Fix iframe startup by avoiding a duplicate ApiClient declaration.
- Load the game in a same-origin page frame so its scripts run under Jellyfin Web's security policy.
- Add a regular Jellyfin user-navigation link that opens the Blind Test outside Dashboard.
- Keep game settings in a separate Dashboard plugin page.
- Show post-answer album artwork as a translucent background in the stage card.
- Fix the final-round button to use the configured round count.
- Add an admin-only Settings link to the main game page and request album image metadata for reliable post-answer artwork.
- Add a main-menu game page, separate admin settings, configurable rounds and preview duration, and post-answer album artwork.
- Label the initial preview action as Play and switch it to Replay after playback.
- Render the Blind Test as a Jellyfin Web page fragment and avoid translation parsing of JavaScript template literals.
- Add a five-round random blind test with five-second song previews and typed title answers.
